chapter: Leading his own band in New York
title: Fielding's style and the band's dress (rough typescript repeat)
summary: A repeated passage on the sweet singer, beautifully dressed band and the Plantation mistake.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: He had a sweet style and then he could scat too. Everybody worshipped him. He was suave and beautifully dressed, he was every bit of dignity and he was dressed like mad.
ALL OF YOU GUYS. THAT WAS ONE OF THE FEATURES OF YOUR BAND. YOU HAD TO BE JUST ABOUT THE BEST BAND IN THE BUSINESS.
IT ALWAYS SEEMD TO BE, IT SEEMS FUNNY TO ME THAT SOMEBODY (inaudible) PROBABLY SIGNED HIM WITH THE BAND.
I don't know why they didn't, but Meyer Davis was just about as big as HE WAS AT THAT TIME.
That was the mistake of the band.
THAT WAS THE BIGGEST MISTAKE THEY EVER MADE.

It was the biggest mistake they ever made not only from the standpoint of what we could tell about what was going to happen about the fire. But I mean that was a big job too. THE PLANTATION WAS A PRETTY WELL KNOWN PLACE.
